pairs.evidence: src/app/loading.tsx:22 Route transitions replace the page, navbar included, with an immediate full-area spinner, so the frame does not stay put and there is no warm-path delay.

techniques.evidence: src/components/navbar/DesktopNav.tsx:67 Desktop hard-codes /dashboard outside useRoutes, the only list MobilePanel renders, and still special-cases /how which that list does not contain.

src/components/navbar/DesktopNav.tsx:64 That desktop-only cluster holds the dashboard link; the mobile panel rebuilds Download from useRoutes and never that destination. The off-canvas menu does close from pathname.

src/components/Navbar.tsx:55 Platform policy is applied in the click handler. The control always renders as Download, so a platform that cannot download looks enabled until the click opens the waitlist.
src/components/navbar/useRoutes.ts:14 Nav entries are label and href only. Searched badge, unread, and count under src/components/navbar and Navbar.tsx and found no nav badge.

src/components/PageTransition.tsx:45 Non-dashboard pathnames are distinct remount keys. Navbar and PageShell's TourProvider are rendered inside that keyed children tree, while CookieConsent and the trackers sit in the root layout outside it.
src/app/loading.tsx:19 The segment fallback is an immediate centered spinner with no navbar and no delay. PageTransition also replays its enter animation on every distinct pathname key.

pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/DesktopSidebar.tsx:58 When a grouped section has any child count, the rail shows only an aria-hidden color dot, so that badge grade has no text equivalent.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/DashboardNavigation.tsx:94 The current view comes from the pathname, parent highlight is section.views.includes(current), and DashLink writes history through navigateDashboard. Unknown segments fail isDashboardViewId.

src/components/dashboard/DesktopSidebar.tsx:17 The second level is the active section's panel; group captions are non-link labels. There is no user collapse control. The phone bar flattens leaves and keeps the rest under More.

src/components/dashboard/DashboardNavigation.tsx:48 Every registry section is rendered. Searched entitlement, featureFlag, requiresPlan, isLocked, canAccess, and upsell in the dashboard nav; the review gate is device reachability, not a hidden or locked entry.

src/components/dashboard/DashboardNavigation.tsx:105 Demo message, incident, and health badges are constants, so they never clear. Review and execution counts are store derivations. The overview parent marker is an aria-hidden dot, numeric badges render with no 99+ cap, and MobileMoreMenu is not given getBadge.

src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx:36 The realtime worker is mounted beside ViewOutlet, renders nothing, and useSyncedRealtime removes the channel and timers on cleanup. Sign-out calls clearUserScopedCaches. Socket failure sets eventStore connectionStatus, which is not the sidebar health chip.

src/components/dashboard/AuthGuard.tsx:37 Until auth resolves, the shell is replaced by a skeleton that includes a fake sidebar. After that, each view is its own dynamic chunk, ViewGap is shapeless with a 160ms ghost delay, hover and focus call preloadView, and keep-alive is capped at 4.

pairs.registryProposal: The shell-paints-first rule never says whether an unresolved session check may withhold the frame. AuthGuard skeletons the whole dashboard, including a fake nav, until identity resolves; if that is forbidden, the technique should say so.
